Subject: POC: Scope & Success Criteria — Recap + Next Steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off the POC:

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: improve customer support triage by surfacing suggested article snippets + routing tags (reduce time-to-first-response)
- Secondary goal: extract structured fields from support transcripts (order id, product code) for downstream analytics
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in average handle time (AHT) on triaged tickets; 85% precision on top-3 suggested articles; 90% extraction accuracy on high-volume entities
- Timeline: 4-week POC (data ingestion + baseline -> 2-week eval -> 1-week tuning)

Action items / owners I propose:
- Redwood: provide sandbox model endpoint, ingestion connector for last 6 months of tickets, evaluation harness + sample prompts (Marissa, Camila)
- Acme: provide s3 export of anonymized transcripts, priority list of entities, and 3 sample workflows for integration (Alex)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the success metrics above or share adjustments by EOD Tuesday.
2) If confirmed, we’ll send an updated POC plan (attachments: initial draft) and schedule a kickoff for the week of June 29.

Attachments: initial POC plan (draft), sample eval matrix (placeholder).

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — clear summary, appreciate it. A couple of adjustments from our side after internal sync:

1) We want to add a mid-POC use case: structured extraction of billing-related fields (invoice number, billing amount, due date). This is high priority for our finance ops team and will be part of the evaluation.
2) Timeline: can we extend the POC by one week if needed? Our data team may take an extra week to produce the anonymized export.
3) Success criteria tweak: for the extraction use case we’re looking for 92% accuracy on the top 5 billing fields — higher bar than the general entities list.

If you can update the POC plan with the new use case and the re-baselined timeline, we’ll sign-off and get the export process started. Also cc’ing our engineering lead on the next email if helpful.

Alex — thanks for the fast turnaround and helpful detail. We can accommodate the billing extraction use case. Proposed re-baseline below (I’ve attached an updated POC_plan_v2.pdf and an evaluation_matrix.xlsx):

Re-baselined scope:
- Core use case (unchanged): support triage + suggested articles
- New/additional use case: billing-related structured extraction (invoice number, amount, due date, billing contact)

Updated success criteria:
- Support triage: 20% reduction in AHT; 85% precision on top-3 article suggestions
- General extraction: 90% entity accuracy on priority list
- Billing extraction: 92% accuracy on top 5 billing fields (as requested)

Updated timeline (contingent on data delivery):
- Week 0 (data handoff): Acme provides anonymized s3 export -> Redwood ingests into sandbox 
- Week 1: baseline models + initial extraction prototypes; quick integration test
- Week 2: evaluation period (metrics collection)
- Week 3: tuning and second-pass models; billing extraction focused iteration
- Week 4: final evaluation and handoff + playbook for productionization

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (commercial), Camila (technical lead), Aditya (SE, extraction pipelines)
- Acme: Alex (product ops), engineering lead to be cc’d for S3 details

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: anonymization removes fields needed for entity mapping -> Mitigation: provide a small labeled sample with synthetic identifiers or do a secure preview run via a masked dataset (we can help with a short script)
- Risk: timeline slip due to export -> Mitigation: we’ll standby for data; if export delays >7 days we’ll compress eval windows and add a final week extension (as requested)

Please confirm these updates in a reply to this thread. Once you confirm we’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and share the updated plan/doc links.

Attachments: POC_plan_v2.pdf, evaluation_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Alex / Marissa,

Quick technical note on the billing extraction request: we’ve done similar extractions for other customers and it’s feasible within the timeline, but a couple things will help improve accuracy:
- Provide a small labeled set (50–100 examples) containing billing fields so we can seed the extractor and tune thresholds.
- If invoice formats vary widely, we’ll prioritize a patterns + model hybrid (regex + model) for precision.
- For data delivery, S3 with a manifest (jsonl or csv) is best; we can accept gzipped jsonl to speed things up.

Aditya will put together a short ingestion checklist and a sample anonymization script (cc’d). We’ll include expected file formats and an estimate of the RAM/CPU requirements for the sandbox run.

Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
